I added a sleep between calls in `tests/test_payments.py`. I didn't run the test, because it's an integration test that sends real requests to the sandbox.

- **The change:** `time.sleep(SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL)` now runs after each `requests.post`. The interval is 0.25s, a bit longer than the 0.2s minimum that 5 requests per second allows, so there's some margin.
- **Extra time:** about 1s per run, since the test makes four calls.

I also saved the 5 requests-per-second limit to the project's EngramDB memory, so future tests that hit the sandbox will space their calls the same way.
